name: glue-vm-results-viewer

smoke_tests: fragmented and concatenated TCP frame receive
Mono8 and RGB24 in-memory bitmap conversion
defect type code to Chinese name mapping
OK frame creates zero disk files
NG frame atomically saves two PNG files and record.json
legacy directory and text TCP compatibility

limitations: The viewer does not execute detection algorithms.
Real VisionMaster continuous-send and reconnect behavior has not been verified.
No production accuracy, cycle-time, or long-duration stability acceptance has been completed.
The default TCP endpoint is local-only and has no authentication or encryption.
Clear-history permanently deletes local NG history.
